name: Tally
author: Nick Scilingo (FocusedOnSound)
description: Tally counts vehicles passing your holiday light show, classifies pass-through vs. parked-to-watch, tracks direction, optionally estimates nearby-device/crowd counts, and can trigger FPP playlists live in response to traffic. Modular hardware support: HLK-LD2410B radar and/or MLX90640 thermal array, with optional BLE/WiFi crowd estimation and BME280 environment logging. Free for personal use.

privacy.summary: Logs vehicle/crowd events from your local radar, thermal, and BLE/WiFi sensors to a local database and, if you enable it, your own MQTT broker. Sends your email only if you register the web UI.

sends.what: your email, a hardware ID derived from the Pi's CPU serial/machine-id, and license key
sends.why: web UI registration and (future) license validation

sends.what: vehicle/parked counters, crowd estimate, temperature/humidity, HA discovery config

collects.what: vehicle pass/parked events: zone, direction, timestamp, dwell time, speed estimate
aggregate BLE/WiFi nearby-device counts (no individual identifiers persisted)
camera classification label and confidence (e.g. "car") for each vehicle event, no images
most recent camera frame (one JPEG, continuously overwritten) for the diagnostics preview
live BLE/WiFi scan detail (MAC, RSSI, name) for the diagnostics page, overwritten each scan

systemChanges.what: creates and enables tally.service (systemd), running as the fpp user
adds a sudoers rule (/etc/sudoers.d/tally) letting fpp restart tally.service only
downloads a pretrained MobileNet-SSD object-detection model from download.tensorflow.org
downloads the model's graph/label files from raw.githubusercontent.com

privacy.other: A hidden, password-gated developer-only camera calibration route exists for sensor tuning; it auto-expires (default 30 min), defaults off after every boot, and its audit log records only activation timestamps, never frame content. There is currently no web UI control to delete stored event history; data accumulates until the database file is removed by hand.
